Question 2
?

Let f be a function with f(2)=3,f′(2)=2,f″(2)=−4 and f‴(2)=6. Which of the following is the third-degree Taylor polynomial for f about x=2?

a
3+2(x−2)−2(x−2)2+(x−2)3
b
3+2(x−2)−4(x−2)2+6(x−2)3
c
3+2(x+2)−4(x+2)2+6(x+2)3
d
3+2(x−2)−4(x−2)2+2(x−2)3
e
3+2(x+2)−2(x+2)2+2(x+2)3
Submit
